name: Survey tile in Cetus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cetus, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 7 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-12-22, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
